cross_platform_audit.scope: Exact parsed observations and sample traces across Windows and Linux release/ASan/UBSan; not CPU/audio/RF measurements.

limits: Cold absolute entry only, not dropped frames in a warm receiver.
Same control payloads and negative seeds; no RF, IQ, voice or CPU measurement.
Full dispatcher/profile feedback and physical device execution are excluded.
Negative entry positions and payloads remain unchanged.
Maximum improvement gate is a bounded existence result; most held-out entries show zero gain.
CMake cache and full build.ninja retained locally with digests; exact command capture, toolchain and measured sources are public.
